view.name: Flight globe
view.description: Full-screen 3D Earth globe with thousands of animated, region-colored planes on dashed great-circle flight arcs, a starfield background, author credit and lat/lng readout.

regions.label: Full-bleed 3D Earth with thousands of dashed colored great-circle flight arcs and plane sprites, nebula/starfield backdrop
dat.GUI panel collapsed to an 'Open Controls' bar; holds folders Flight/Flight Path/Plane/Space/Performance/Earth/Brightness controls
GitHub 'Made by jeantimex' credit bottom-left and monospace Lat/Lng camera readout bottom-right

evidence.note: Satellite-textured 3D globe with flight route polylines and plane markers; day/night shading
Geographic camera coordinate readout, updates as globe rotates

patterns.rationale: The stage is a rotatable 3D globe in a WebGL canvas, but its purpose is geographic flight-route visualization rather than inspecting an object's form; coded primarily as map-explorer. Orbit drag not verified.

evidence.note: Realistically lit 3D Earth mesh with atmosphere glow, auto-rotating

Collapsed dat.GUI panel; accessibility tree shows 7 folders (Flight Controls, Flight Path, Plane Controls, Space Controls, Performance Controls, Earth Controls, Brightness Controls) with toggles, sliders, select and color field
Whole panel collapses/expands; live check: each folder header (e.g. 'Plane Controls') expands its rows in place with a caret indicator, others stay closed
Hidden in capture inside collapsed panel; dat.GUI numeric sliders (Flight Count 5000, Dash Length, Plane Size, Fly Speed, Time Slider, Day/Night brightness) with paired number box
Inside collapsed panel: checkboxes (Return Flight, Hide Path, Star Cloud, Day/Night Effect...) and a Pane/SVG dropdown select

patterns.rationale: dat.GUI color controller (Plane Color #ff0000) exists in the collapsed panel; its picker popup was not opened.

evidence.note: Plane Color field shown as red swatch with hex value when panel is open

patterns.rationale: Only numeric boxes paired with sliders and a disabled Time (UTC) field; not standalone text inputs.

evidence.note: Disabled Time (UTC) textbox in Earth Controls
Controls panel is a collapsible floating dat.GUI box, not an edge-sliding drawer
Flight arcs are geographic overlays, not a chart

structure.layout: full-viewport WebGL canvas (3D globe in starfield) with a floating dat.GUI controls panel top-right (collapsed to 'Open Controls'), attribution bottom-left and lat/lng readout bottom-right

aesthetics.typography: Lucida Grande 11px for dat.GUI panel labels; Arial 13–14px for inputs and 'Made by jeantimex' credit; monospace 12px for Lat/Lng readout
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat, utilitarian: 11px panel labels, 12px mono readout, 14px credit; no headings

notes: Three.js tech demo: photoreal Earth (blue ocean tint, clouds, atmosphere rim glow, day/night terminator) slowly auto-rotating against a colourful nebula + starfield; ~5000 instanced flights drawn as rainbow-coloured dashed great-circle arcs with plane sprites/markers. All UI is overlay: stock dark dat.GUI panel (black/#303030 rows, coloured left-edge type stripes, #2fa1d6 slider fills) collapsed to 'Open Controls' in the capture; GitHub credit bottom-left; monospace lat/lng readout bottom-right that updates live. No headings or landmarks.
